manual_findings.aspect: RTL text reading order
manual_findings.target: printbatch.charge.value; printbatch.summary; job subtitles and prices
manual_findings.expected: Mirror leading/trailing layout while preserving readable English/number strings, including 28 cr
manual_findings.observed: Charge visually places cr before its number; summary count and subtitle page count migrate to the opposite end. Row positions and mode order do mirror.
manual_findings.scope: Listed header frame plus this state's actually viewed target frames; no inference to other states.
manual_findings.rationale: Native labels retain the exact English source strings, but visual bidi rendering reorders their neutral/number runs.

source_hypothesis.reason: BatchText inherits RTL paragraph direction for mixed English and leading-number strings. Text direction should be distinct from row layout direction.

uncertain_unmapped_issues.scope: Native session failed with exit65, one failed test. Initial intervals0–600 and260–860 cover only860 of868 units; final8 units missing. Bottom-reached flag does not override incomplete interval union. Later P2.s5 is separately complete.
All30 original callback failures remain failed in their reports. Separate JSON decoding shows whether interval payload objects match; no corrected report is substituted.
P2.s1 and P3.s1/s2 are observer-blocked disabled actions on each platform. Their current disabled state is observed separately, but blocked dispatch provides no handler behavior verdict.
Touch/AX height checks can conflict between full and partial viewport frames and can produce subpixel below48 values. All original failed and unassessed rows remain explicit.
The assigned Android adapter does not export stateDescription as an expanded property. The original expanded-native assertions remain unassessed; labels and breakdown presence are distinct facts.

iOS native runtime records canvas_color=systemBackground: outside the card is white/black, differing from the brief's custom canvas palette. This is observer-host scope, not attributed to the production card from current evidence.

404 original native overflow failures remain unresolved. Screenshots do not show obvious glyph truncation, and the host sentinel also flags overflow. No blanket product pass or failure-count reduction is made.
Exact SwiftUI fonts, padding, colors, corner radii and physical hit regions are not read from AX or inferred from source. Visual hierarchy is visible; exact unsupported style aspects remain unknown.
Intermediate checkpoints retain complete=false. Their joint target frames are not promoted to full-content sweeps, and absent collapsed contents cannot be proven from one viewport.

All115 listed raw images were viewed as viewport contact sheets at390×600. P2/P3 views were horizontally rescaled from320 to390; this preserves text/overlap evidence but is not evidence of original font proportions or geometry. Raw original PNGs remain unchanged. The full raw iOS P1.s0 image was also viewed directly.

Some immediate Android images show pre-transition checkbox/thumb pixels while totals already update; later bound frames show the settled state. Native facts and callback intervals are retained separately. This may be standard Material animation and is not declared a persistent selection defect.
